archetypes.name: dyn-env-ctx
archetypes.rationale: Ctx snapshot ordering and env precedence are the highest-risk changed behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed ctx adoption paths in agents.py, design_lifecycle.py, and plan_quality.py. Focus on whether rehydrate, argv override, quiet_init, and normalization happen before Ctx snapshots. Check that legacy ctx=None behavior still reads ambient env where unconverted callers remain. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-quiet-routing
archetypes.rationale: Moving quiet_init into lifecycle cores can affect fd routing and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review direct step5c_core and step_final_summary_core behavior after quiet_init moved into the cores. Check contract output, fd3/fd4 routing, stdout capture helpers, and environment restoration. Verify final summary rendering and marker emission still use explicit paths instead of ambient env. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
